title: Timeline moves not to use
text: Don't: Shift+Q/W or Q/W on a layered timeline (they trimmed the cover), E (disabled the clip instead of extending), Insert Frame Hold Segment (ripples every track), Close Gap from the menu (did nothing). Mark Clip takes the topmost clip (the cover), not the body. Track locks don't stop API edits. Linked Selection on: a video-only selection + Clear does nothing.
